reason: Premise-denial with a wrong figure: answers 'Hapana ... 765,900 -- si 400,000' for mining. correct_value: GN 605A: energy sector, international companies 765,900/month; mining and prospecting minerals 695,000/month; the mining sector has further sub-sector rates (primary mining licence, dealer and broker licences)

row.question_sw: Mshahara wa chini wa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa ni Shilingi 400,000 — je, namba hii ni sahihi?
row.answer_sw: Hapana. Kwa sekta ya madini ya kimataifa na nishati, kiwango cha mshahara wa chini chini ya GN 605A ni karibu Shilingi 765,900 kwa mwezi — si Shilingi 400,000. Hii ndiyo kiwango cha juu zaidi katika agizo lote.
row.question_en: The minimum wage for international mining is TZS 400,000 — is this figure correct?
row.answer_en: No. For the international mining and energy sector the GN 605A minimum wage floor is approximately TZS 765,900 per month — not TZS 400,000. This is the highest rate in the entire order.
